notes: Full description: LintProfile::lint_runner (pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:670) returns a LintRunner but is not annotated with #[must_use]. If a caller writes 'profile.lint_runner();' without capturing the result, the compiler emits no warning. Since the entire purpose of calling lint_runner() is to obtain a runner for subsequent use, silently discarding it is always a bug. Fix: add #[must_use] to the lint_runner() method in the LintProfile trait definition. Consistent with the existing #[must_use] on LintRunner::new(), LintRunner::run_cert() etc. in the same codebase.
title: RUSTY: LintProfile::lint_runner missing #[must_use]
